nc_mining_rules: Uses train split Teacher NC labels ONLY (dev/validation/blind labels NOT read)
Per-task NC cell cap: max 8 hard-negative cells per task
Per-parent-state cap: max 4 reserve cells per parent state
If a task has no known NC parent states, zero hard-negative cells for that task
NC parent states selected from primary labels (train TV=159 NC=41)
coverage_rules: Selection: parent states with fewest primary samples per task
Coverage cell selection is label-independent (does not use NC/TV)
perturbation_rules: Each cell specifies exact (dx_m, dy_m, dyaw_rad), NOT just template name
Perturbation applied to free-joint qpos AFTER set_init_state, BEFORE dummy_wait
P0 excluded (already collected at density=1 per state in primary)
Templates: P1(+5mm x), P2(-5mm x), P3(+5mm y), P4(-5mm y), P5(+5deg yaw), P6(-5deg yaw), P7(random_10mm)

hard_negative_invariant: Every cell with selection_source=hard_negative MUST have parent_state in per_task_nc_parent_states[task] — verified at manifest generation time

effective_duplicate_check.note: All 80 cells must have unique (task, parent_state, effective_dx, effective_dy, effective_dyaw) in primary+reserve combined set

collection_rule: All 80 cells must be collected. Collection stops only after all 80 complete or a hard error. Must NOT stop early after reaching NC=39.
